 SEEKING TO QUASH ALL THE CONSEQUENTIAL PROCEEDINGS  INITIATED AGAINST THE PETITIONER/ACCUSED IN CC  NO.834/2016, PENDING ON THE FILE OF COURT OF JMFC-II, AT  BELAGAVI, IMPUGNED COMPLAINT, FIR AND CHARGE SHEET  REGISTERED BY MALMARUTI POLICE STATION, BELAGAVI, IN  CONNECTION WITH THE CRIME NO.153/2013 FOR THE OFFENCES  PUNISHABLE U/S 406, 408, 420 AND 201 OF IPC 1860.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HEMANT  CHANDANGOUDAR  ORAL ORDER
The petitioner, who is facing trial for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 408, 420 and 201 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, is before this Court.

2. The case of the prosecution is that during the period 2007-2013, while the petitioner was working as the Manager of M/s Zamzam Weigh Bridge, owned by C.W.5, he allegedly misappropriated a sum of 18,78,666.67.
It is alleged that the petitioner collected money from customers but failed to deposit the same with the owner.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1- State, and the learned counsel for respondent No.2.
4.

It is alleged that the petitioner, while serving as the Manager of M/s Zamzam Weigh Bridge,
misappropriated 18,78,666.67.
The second respondent, claiming to be the Power of Attorney Holder of C.W.5, lodged the First Information Report (FIR) on 29.07.2013.

A perusal of the FIR reveals that C.W.5, the owner of the weighbridge, became aware of the alleged NC:
2025:KHC-D:434 misappropriation upon being informed by third parties that the petitioner had retained the money collected from customers.
5.
Apart from the allegation of misappropriation, no documentary evidence has been produced to substantiate the charges against the petitioner.

In the absence of any credible evidence to support the allegations, the continuation of criminal proceedings against the petitioner would amount to an Mohammed Zakariya S/O Abdul Karim Attar vs State By Malmaruti Ps on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134179421/
2 abuse of the process of law.
6.
